data.text: Good to see everyone. My family taught me to leave enough fish for next month, and I want this lake supporting our village for years. With 100 tons in the lake, we can each catch 10 tons this month, leaving 50 to double back to 100. That’s $10,000 each per month if we keep to it. Can we agree to that limit and check in together after each month’s catches are revealed? John, what do you think?
